actions.description: Copy a storage object within or between buckets in Supabase.
actions.name: copy-storage-object

sourceKey.description: Path of the source object within the bucket. Example: "docs/readme.txt"

destinationKey.description: Path for the copied object in the destination bucket. Example: "docs/readme-copy.txt"

actions.description: Create an auth user in Supabase.
actions.name: create-auth-user

actions.description: Generate a signed URL that allows a client to upload a file directly to Supabase Storage without exposing the service role key.
actions.name: create-signed-upload-url

path.description: Object path within the bucket. Example: "uploads/file.txt"

signed_url.description: Absolute signed URL the client can PUT to.

token.description: Token included in the signed URL.

actions.description: Generate a time-limited signed URL for accessing a private storage object.
actions.name: create-signed-url

path.description: Object path within the bucket. Example: "data/sample.txt"

expires_in.description: Expiry time in seconds. Defaults to 3600.

signed_url.description: Absolute URL for accessing the object.

actions.description: Create a storage bucket in Supabase.
actions.name: create-storage-bucket

id.description: Unique identifier for the bucket. Example: "my-bucket"

name.description: Display name for the bucket. Defaults to id if omitted.

public.description: Whether the bucket is publicly accessible. Defaults to false.

file_size_limit.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Example: 10485760

actions.description: Upload a storage object to Supabase Storage.
actions.name: create-storage-object

path.description: The object path within the bucket. Example: "docs/readme.txt"

content.description: The file content as a string. For binary files, base64-encode and decode before sending.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the file. Example: "text/plain"

upsert.description: If true, overwrite an existing object with the same path.

actions.description: Delete an MFA factor for a user in Supabase.
actions.name: delete-auth-factor

factor_id.description: MFA factor UUID to delete. Example: "b1c2d3e4-f5a6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"

actions.description: Delete or archive a auth user in Supabase.
actions.name: delete-auth-user

user_id.description: The UUID of the auth user to delete. Example: "afece930-4935-43c3-9484-46bc38da98f7"

actions.description: Delete or archive a storage bucket in Supabase.
actions.name: delete-storage-bucket

bucket_id.description: Storage bucket ID to delete. Example: "nango-del-bucket-1"

actions.description: Delete or archive a storage object in Supabase.
actions.name: delete-storage-object

actions.description: Delete rows from a Supabase table.
actions.name: delete-table-rows

table.description: Name of the table to delete rows from. Example: "nango_test"

filters.description: PostgREST filters as query parameters. Example: {"name": "eq.del-row-1"}

returnRepresentation.description: If true, adds Prefer: return=representation to return deleted rows

actions.description: Generate a magic link, OTP, invite, signup, or recovery link for a user.
actions.name: generate-auth-link

new_email.description: New email address for email_change_current and email_change_new link types.

data.description: Optional extra metadata to attach to the user.

actions.description: Retrieve a single auth user from Supabase.
actions.name: get-auth-user

userId.description: The UUID of the user to retrieve. Example: "a02e344e-4eba-473d-b299-b751cbd1fa2c"

actions.description: Retrieve a single storage bucket from Supabase.
actions.name: get-storage-bucket

actions.description: Retrieve metadata for a single storage object from Supabase.
actions.name: get-storage-object

path.description: Object path within the bucket. Example: "docs/readme.txt"

actions.description: Insert a row into a Supabase table.
actions.name: insert-table-row

table.description: The table name to insert into. Example: "nango_test"

row.description: The row object to insert. Example: {"name": "new-record", "value": "delta"}

actions.description: Call a Supabase Postgres function via PostgREST.
actions.name: invoke-rpc

function_name.description: Name of the Postgres function in the public schema. Example: "nango_hello"

args.description: Function arguments as a JSON object. Example: {"name": "world"}

read_only.description: Set to true for read-only functions to use GET (enables caching). Defaults to false (POST).

actions.description: List MFA factors enrolled for a specific user in Supabase.
actions.name: list-auth-factors

user_id.description: The UUID of the Supabase Auth user whose MFA factors to list. Example: "a02e344e-4eba-473d-b299-b751cbd1fa2c"

actions.description: List auth users from Supabase.
actions.name: list-auth-users

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 50.

actions.description: List storage buckets from Supabase.
actions.name: list-storage-buckets

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return. Example: 10

offset.description: Number of buckets to skip. Example: 0

search.description: Search term to filter bucket names. Example: "prod"

actions.description: List storage objects from Supabase.
actions.name: list-storage-objects

prefix.description: Folder path prefix to filter objects. Example: "docs/"

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return. Default: 100

next_offset.description: Offset to use for the next page of results.

actions.description: Query rows from a Supabase table through PostgREST.
actions.name: query-table-rows

column.description: Column name to filter on. Example: "name"

offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Example: 0

count.description: Total row count when count was requested

actions.description: Update an auth user in Supabase.
actions.name: update-auth-user

user_id.description: The unique ID of the user to update. Example: "a02e344e-4eba-473d-b299-b751cbd1fa2c"

email.description: New email address for the user.

phone.description: New phone number for the user.

actions.description: Update a storage bucket in Supabase.
actions.name: update-storage-bucket

public.description: Whether the bucket is publicly accessible

fileSizeLimit.description: Maximum file size in bytes or as a string like "100MB"

actions.description: Update a storage object in Supabase.
actions.name: update-storage-object

bucket_id.description: The bucket ID containing the object. Example: "nango-test-public"

path.description: The current path of the object. Example: "docs/readme.txt"

new_path.description: The new path for the object (to move/rename). Mutually exclusive with content.

new_bucket_id.description: The destination bucket ID for moving. Defaults to the source bucket if not provided.

content.description: New file content to overwrite the object. Use this for text files. Mutually exclusive with new_path.

content_type.description: MIME type for the new content. Defaults to text/plain if content is provided.

actions.description: Update rows in a Supabase table.
actions.name: update-table-rows

filters.description: PostgREST filters as query params. Example: {"id":"eq.964cc467-144e-4215-b7d0-d124607a6d72"}

actions.description: Insert or update a row in a Supabase table, merging on conflict.
actions.name: upsert-table-row

row.description: Row object to upsert. Must include the primary key column(s) for conflict detection.

on_conflict.description: Comma-separated conflict target column(s) if different from the primary key. Example: "name"

syncs.description: Sync rows from a configured Supabase table.
syncs.name: table-rows
